nodes.description: mapping(address=>bool) authorized in pToken; whitelist gate controlling who may mint or burn tokens
address private _owner in Ownable; privileged account used by the onlyOwner modifier
mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances in ERC20; stores each account token balance
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances in ERC20; spender approvals
uint256 private _totalSupply in ERC20; total amount of minted tokens
pToken.mint(address _to,uint256 _amount); requires authorized[msg.sender] then calls _mint to create tokens
pToken.burn(address _from,uint256 _amount); requires authorized[msg.sender] then calls _burn to destroy tokens
pToken.addAuthorized(address _toAdd) onlyOwner; grants mint/burn authorization
pToken.removeAuthorized(address _toRemove) onlyOwner; revokes mint/burn authorization
ERC20.transfer(address recipient,uint256 amount); moves tokens from _msgSender() via _transfer
ERC20.transferFrom(address sender,address recipient,uint256 amount); moves tokens and decrements allowance
ERC20.approve(address spender,uint256 amount); sets allowance via _approve
ERC20._transfer internal; debits sender balance and credits recipient balance
ERC20._approve internal; writes the _allowances mapping
Ownable modifier onlyOwner; requires _owner == _msgSender() before executing the guarded function
Address.sendValue(address payable recipient,uint256 amount) internal; performs a low-level value transfer call
Address._functionCallWithValue private; performs a low-level call with arbitrary data and value to a target
msg.sender / _msgSender(); caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and token movement
_mint(address account,uint256 amount) state-changing token creation; increases _totalSupply and _balances
_burn(address account,uint256 amount) state-changing token destruction; reduces _balances and _totalSupply
recipient.call{value: amount}("") low-level external call transferring Ether; potential reentrancy sink
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) low-level external call with attacker-influenced target and calldata; potential reentrancy sink
_to parameter of pToken.mint; recipient of newly minted tokens
_amount parameter of pToken.mint; amount of tokens to create
_from parameter of pToken.burn; account whose tokens are destroyed
_amount parameter of pToken.burn; amount of tokens to destroy
_toAdd parameter of addAuthorized; address granted mint/burn rights
_toRemove parameter of removeAuthorized; address losing mint/burn rights
recipient parameter of Address.sendValue; target of the value transfer
amount parameter of Address.sendValue; wei value forwarded
target parameter of Address._functionCallWithValue; contract invoked by the low-level call
data parameter of Address._functionCallWithValue; calldata passed to the target
weiValue parameter of Address._functionCallWithValue; value attached to the call
bool success local in _functionCallWithValue capturing the low-level call result
bytes returndata local in _functionCallWithValue holding the raw return payload of the call

edges.reason: msg.sender is used to index the authorized mapping inside mint to decide whether the caller may mint
msg.sender is used to index the authorized mapping inside burn to decide whether the caller may burn
authorized mapping read in require(authorized[msg.sender]) gates mint
authorized mapping read in require(authorized[msg.sender]) gates burn
addAuthorized writes authorized[_toAdd] = true, granting privileged mint/burn rights
removeAuthorized writes authorized[_toRemove] = false, revoking privileged rights
onlyOwner modifier guards addAuthorized against unauthorized callers
onlyOwner modifier guards removeAuthorized against unauthorized callers
_owner state variable is read and compared to _msgSender() inside the onlyOwner modifier
mint invokes the _mint state-changing token creation routine
_to parameter of mint flows into _mint as the credited account
_amount parameter of mint flows into _mint as the created amount
burn invokes the _burn state-changing token destruction routine
_from parameter of burn flows into _burn as the debited account
_amount parameter of burn flows into _burn as the destroyed amount
_mint increases _totalSupply with the minted amount
_mint increases the recipient entry in _balances
_burn decreases _totalSupply by the burned amount
_burn decreases the account entry in _balances
sendValue executes a low-level value call to an arbitrary recipient, the external call sink
recipient parameter becomes the callee of the low-level call, so an attacker-controlled address can reenter
amount parameter is forwarded as the wei value of the low-level call
_functionCallWithValue executes a low-level call with caller-supplied target, data and value
target parameter is the external contract invoked, allowing a malicious callee to reenter
data parameter is attacker-influenced calldata executed by the target, enabling arbitrary external calls
weiValue parameter sets the Ether value attached to the low-level call
success local captures the boolean result of the low-level call
returndata local captures the raw bytes returned by the low-level call
_toAdd parameter is the address written into the authorized mapping by addAuthorized
_toRemove parameter is the address cleared in the authorized mapping by removeAuthorized
transfer delegates token movement to the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom delegates token movement to the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom updates the spender allowance through _approve
approve writes the allowance through _approve
_approve stores the allowance in the _allowances mapping
_transfer updates sender and recipient entries of _balances

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only consumed by the _mint invocation inside mint, so it folds into that unsafe operation
_amount is only consumed by the _mint invocation inside mint, so it folds into that unsafe operation
_from is only consumed by the _burn invocation inside burn, so it folds into that unsafe operation
_amount is only consumed by the _burn invocation inside burn, so it folds into that unsafe operation
_toAdd is the sole argument written to the authorized mapping by addAuthorized
_toRemove is the sole argument cleared in the authorized mapping by removeAuthorized
recipient is the callee of the low-level value call in sendValue
amount is the wei value attached to the low-level call in sendValue
target is the callee of the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue
data is the calldata supplied to the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue
weiValue is the Ether value attached to the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue
success is a transient local holding only the low-level call outcome
returndata is a transient local holding only the low-level call payload
